subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should this issue remain the canonical design thread for a durable final-delivery ownership obligation, and which existing substrate should own that obligation?
rationale: Current main has a narrower requester-key routing seam, while the issue now asks for a broader owner-mode and delivery-confirmation invariant that changes public API, persisted state, and message-delivery semantics.

options.title: Keep this as canonical and design the substrate
options.body: Use this issue to decide whether subagent registry, task delivery state, or outbound delivery should own durable final-delivery obligations before asking for a new focused PR.

options.title: Declare `completionOwnerKey` sufficient
options.body: Close or narrow this issue if maintainers decide the shipped requester-key routing seam is the intended boundary and remaining problems should be filed as concrete channel bugs.

options.title: Split by affected surface
options.body: Move the remaining work into narrower issues such as plugin runtime delivery, Slack origin tuple loss, and background task survival if a cross-surface ownership contract is not desired.

recommendation.title: Keep this as canonical and design the substrate
recommendation.body: Use this issue to decide whether subagent registry, task delivery state, or outbound delivery should own durable final-delivery obligations before asking for a new focused PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They co-authored the current routing seam and touched adjacent plugin subagent tracking, making them a good product/API routing owner for the remaining choice.
